name: Construction subcontractor back office: surety-ready job-cost/WIP bookkeeping + Illinois certified payroll (Chicagoland public-works subs)
summary: Customer unit = one Illinois specialty/sub contractor ($1-20M revenue) on a fixed monthly fee for accrual close + job-cost report + quarterly WIP schedule for the surety/bank, with an IDOL certified-payroll filing add-on for months with prevailing-wage work. Payroll itself stays on a platform of record (client-paid or pass-through). Founder performs production for the first ~12 clients; bookkeepers, a senior construction reviewer and a compliance specialist are hired on client-count triggers. One-time revenue = onboarding/clean-up project. No CPA title, no attest work, no lien filing, no surety sales.
evidence_notes: Bookkeeping is not restricted to CPAs in Illinois: 225 ILCS 450/8.05(b)(3) says bookkeeping and tax preparation 'are not restricted to licensed or registered CPAs' [A, DB-S014]; titles 'certified public accountant', 'public accountant', 'C.P.A.' or similar misleading terms are barred, civil penalty up to $10,000 per offense [A, DB-S015]; assurance/opinion reports are CPA practice [A, DB-S016].

Certified payroll mandate: monthly by the 15th, per project, for every contractor and sub on Illinois public works [A, C5-S014, C5-S017]; Davis-Bacon-only contracts do not file with IDOL; no filing for months without work; liability 'falls with the individual contractor'; a filer entering payrolls for two companies needs a separate log-in per company - i.e., third-party filing is contemplated [A, DB-S013]. SB1344 penalties reach the filing agent [C, C5-S019].

Price anchors: vertical construction bookkeeping lists $500-$1,000 (specialty sub), $900-$1,800 (WIP/retainage), $1,600-$2,800+ (multi-entity) [D, C5-S009]; the same vendor's Chicago ZIP pages show $150-$300 for small businesses (inconsistent) [D, DB-S029]; Bench accrual tiers $699-$999+ [B, C5-S003]; AI-only tiers $65-$99 [B, C5-S004/S005]; offshore 'construction-trained' bookkeeper $999/mo [D, C5-S035].

Certified-payroll software substitutes are cheap: LCPcertified $12/report or $145/mo for up to 5 active projects [B, DB-S020]; PaidReady $49-$99/mo [B, DB-S021]; Points North on ADP $175/mo + $7.50/report [B, C5-S013]. A done-for-you add-on must be sold on labour/penalty avoidance, not software.

Bond trigger: Illinois public works over $150,000 require performance/payment bonds until 2029 ($50,000 after), IDOT/Tollway over $500,000 [A, DB-S017]; SBA guarantees bonds up to $9M non-federal [A, DB-S028]. That surety underwriting asks for WIP schedules is industry practice, documented here only at D (vendor pages) - MISSING at A/B.

Prospect pool: City of Chicago SBI/LSLR/JOC awards to small contractors 2022-2026 [A, DB-S018]; 226 federal specialty-trade construction awards to Illinois-based recipients FY2025-27 [A, DB-S019]; Illinois has ~18,685 specialty-trade establishments, ~5,200 with 5-49 employees [C, C5-S002].

Incumbent benchmark: Paychex 82-83% client retention, >50% of payroll clients via referrals [A, WS02-S022] (incumbent economics). Illinois bookkeeping firms with <5 employees average ~$189k receipts; 5-9 employees ~$731k [C, C5-S001].

Lead volumes, conversion rates, attach rates and churn for THIS entrant are E. BLS wage data for bookkeepers could not be retrieved (API daily limit) - staff costs anchored on Census payroll/employee (C) plus burden (E).

STAGE E (2026-11-28): Surety demand for WIP now documented at B: Tokio Marine HCC's contract bond packet requires two FYE statements plus a current interim if the FYE is >6 months old and a Work-on-Hand schedule (contract price, estimated cost at completion, billed to date, cost to date) [B, E-SYN006-S004]; Western National's Central-region (incl. IL) chart offers 'Xpress Xtra' bonding to $1.5M aggregate with 'No C.P.A. Requirement', underwritten on business statements, personal financial statements, a bank letter and a WIP schedule [B, E-SYN006-S005]. Counter-evidence: SBA QuickApp (contracts <= $500k) and carrier express programs (<= $500k on a 1-page application and credit) need little or no WIP [A, E-SYN006-S006/S007; B, E-SYN006-S005] - so the buyer is the sub graduating past ~$500k jobs.

STAGE E correction: LCPcertified describes itself as certified-payroll reporting 'for an individual organization' and lists only CA/WA/MD state exports [B, E-SYN006-S010]; the Stage D firm-level multi-client licence ($210/mo) is replaced by in-house IDOL-template tooling ($75/mo base).

STAGE E: Insureon bookkeeper medians E&O $37/mo ($1M/$1M) and cyber $47/mo [D, E-SYN006-S008] are a floor; base keeps $275/mo because certified-payroll filing (SB1344 agent penalties [C, C5-S019]) and surety reliance raise the risk class (E).

STAGE E: BLS May 2025 median pay for bookkeeping/accounting clerks $50,670 nationally and $54,890 in construction [C, E-SYN006-S009]; base bookkeeper $5,800/mo loaded (~$58k + 20%) is consistent; conservative raised to $6,400.
STAGE E: an external part-time construction-accounting reviewer (QA on WIP/job-cost) is added from month 3 because the founder has no construction-accounting track record; hourly rate MISSING (E).
STAGE E standardization: owner draw $4,000/mo from month 13 in all scenarios; tax 30%; start capital = smallest base-case injection keeping cash >= 0; long-term drivers evidenced below.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: No licence needed for bookkeeping [A, DB-S014]; setup = LLC, E&O/cyber policy, engagement letter, software (days-weeks) (E).
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Stage A/C: 1-6 weeks; owner decides; trigger = surety/bank request or first public award [E, WS02-028 memo].
drivers.founder_ramp_months__source: Founder must first learn construction accrual/WIP and IDOL template; referral relationships take months (E).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified owner conversations from public award lists (Chicago SBI/LSLR/JOC [A, DB-S018], USASpending [A, DB-S019]), ASA/FWC/CFMA events (Porte Brown lists these associations [B, DB-S023]) and CPA/surety-agent introductions. Volume E.
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Proposal requires a books review/discovery call (E).
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: No benchmark found; switching friction is low (client owns QBO file) but trust barrier is high for an unknown firm (E).
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Paychex: >50% of payroll clients via CPA/bank/broker referrals [A, WS02-S022] (incumbent). New-entrant referral rate E.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Paychex retention 82-83%/yr ~1.5%/mo [A, WS02-S022, incumbent]; base slightly worse. Conservative raised to 2.5%/mo (~26%/yr) in Stage E: a new entrant's first clients skew to clean-up/troubled books and contractors fail in downturns (E).
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Blended: close+job cost+WIP $700-$1,000 (vertical list $500-$1,800 [D, C5-S009]; Bench accrual $699-$999 [B, C5-S003]) plus certified-payroll add-on ~$250-$350 on ~40% of clients for ~9.5 months (E; software substitute $49-$190/mo [B, DB-S020/S021, C5-S013]).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Onboarding/clean-up (job setup, cost codes, opening WIP) typical at onboarding [E, WS02-028 memo]; price unbenchmarked.
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Direct costs here are per-client tools only (labour is in Staff): WIP tool $20-70/mo [D, C5-S036]; certified-payroll software $12/report or $145/mo per 5 projects [B, DB-S020]; QBO subscription normally client-paid (E). ~$100-160 per client-month.
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: Clean-up done by founder/staff (labour in Staff); direct cost = software/setup only (E).
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Meetings, travel, event fees per won client (E).
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: CFMA Chicago associate membership $500/yr [B, E-SYN006-S011]; ASA Chicago/FWC dues MISSING; website, award-list mailers, event fees (E).
drivers.dso_days__source: Monthly in advance by ACH/card is the online-bookkeeper norm (Bench annual prepay [B, C5-S003]); Stage E conservative 30 days because contractors habitually pay by check net-30 (E).
drivers.founder_draw_per_month__source: Stage E standardization rule: modest living stipend $4,000/mo from month 13 in all scenarios (cross-finalist comparability).
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Multiple of operating profit BEFORE owner pay (SDE-like). Bookkeeping-practice multiples MISSING; anchors: a Chicago-suburb owner-operated service business asked ~3.2x SDE [D, DF-S004]; sub-$1M-EBITDA insurance agencies ~4x EBITDA [C, WS02-S007]; small insurance books 5-7x profit [C, C5-S021] (stickier commission streams). Recurring bookkeeping books are sticky but key-person heavy -> 1.5/2.5/3.5x.
drivers.tax_rate_pct__source: Stage E standardization rule (simplified blended pass-through rate).
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Smallest base-case injection (rounded up to $1k) that keeps the base-case monthly cash balance >= 0 with the $4k/mo draw (Stage E rule); computed from the rebuilt model.
drivers.lt_growth_y6_pct__source: Model y4->y5 operating-profit growth is ~+33% base / ~+100% conservative from a low base; an Illinois-only public-works niche decelerates as the founder-led pipeline saturates. Illinois has ~18,685 specialty-trade establishments [C, C5-S002]; Chicago alone has 400k+ lead service lines to replace over decades [C, E-SYN006-S012]. Conservative 3% ~ inflation-only.
drivers.lt_growth_decay__source: Analyst assumption; conservative decays fastest (construction cyclicality; AI price compression of generic bookkeeping [A, C5-S008]).
drivers.incremental_roic_pct__source: Growth capital in this business is hiring-ahead payroll plus small working capital; years 1-5 base op of ~$190k is reached on <$15k peak funding (model). Years 6-10 assume $1 of reinvested cash adds $1.00 of annual op (base), $0.50 (conservative: geographic expansion beyond Illinois needs new state rules and sales staff).
drivers.maint_capex_pct_op__source: Laptops/monitors ~$1.5-2k per seat every ~3-4 years and security tooling; capex per hire $2,000 in the staff table (E).
drivers.reserve_months__source: Staff is ~65-75% of cash costs; 2 months of payroll cover (3 conservative) protects against a client-loss shock (E).

staff.role: External construction-accounting reviewer (part-time QA on WIP/job cost)
staff.notes: Stage E addition: ~5-8 h/mo of review by an experienced construction controller/CPA (no attest, no CPA association with our reports) while the founder learns; continues as second-level QA. Hourly rate MISSING (E).

~$58k salary + ~20% burden; BLS May 2025 median bookkeeping clerk $50,670 (US) / $54,890 in construction [C, E-SYN006-S009]; Census 541219 payroll/employee ~$45k [C, DB-S036]. 15 clients per bookkeeper (E). Founder covers the first ~12 clients.
~$85k + burden; reviews WIP/revenue recognition (E). Stage C base used $90k.
Maps hours to project/classification/county rate; IDOL template; fringe reconciliation (E).

overhead.notes: Insureon bookkeeper medians: E&O $37/mo, cyber $47/mo [D, E-SYN006-S008] = floor. Base $275 for higher limits and the certified-payroll/surety-reliance risk class (E); coverage of SB1344 agent penalties MISSING.

overhead.item: Practice software: Claude Team seats, practice-management, document capture, e-sign
overhead.notes: Claude Team $25/seat/mo monthly [B, DB-S022]; QBO Accountant access normally free to firms (E); practice-management ~$50/user (E).

overhead.item: Certified-payroll tooling (IDOL Excel template automation, secure client portal)
overhead.notes: Stage E correction: LCPcertified is licensed per organization and lists no IDOL export [B, E-SYN006-S010], so no multi-client firm licence; IDOL's fixed-column Excel template is free [A, C5-S017]. Where a client needs software (e.g., WH-347), it is client-paid (PaidReady $49/mo [B, DB-S021]).
Includes engagement-letter legal review, LLC annual report $75 [A, E-SYN006-S014], CPA tax prep for the firm, phone, website, co-working (E).

capex.notes: Equipment and secure file setup (E). LLC articles $150 + assumed name $120 (2026) [A, E-SYN006-S014] are expensed in month 1 overhead rounding.

transactions.name: Specialty sub ($4M revenue, 25 employees, 2 public jobs): monthly close + job cost + quarterly WIP + certified payroll on 2 IDOL projects

lines.item: Compliance specialist 3 h (2 projects x 4-5 weekly payrolls) @ $33

transactions.notes: Price = $950 close/WIP + $300 certified payroll (E within D range [C5-S009]); certified-payroll software alternatives $145-$667/mo (LCPcertified [B, DB-S020]; Dapt on ADP $8,000/yr for 1-5 jobs [B, E-SYN006-S013]). Payment: monthly in advance by ACH (E).

transactions.name: Small sub ($1.2M, 8 employees, no public work): monthly close + job cost, WIP twice a year
transactions.notes: Low end of vertical list [D, C5-S009]; competes with Bench Complexity 2 $699 [B, C5-S003].

transactions.name: Onboarding / clean-up project (one-time): rebuild 6 months, set up cost codes and opening WIP
transactions.notes: Price unbenchmarked (E). Often triggered by a surety asking for a current interim + Work-on-Hand schedule [B, E-SYN006-S004/S005]. Paid 50% upfront, 50% on delivery (E).

transactions.name: Certified-payroll-only client (seasonal, 1 IDOL project, 9 months/yr)
transactions.notes: Stand-alone add-on is low-ticket; must lead into bookkeeping (Stage C finding).
